correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md blob 3342c419395221ab3094cdfb5c0ceb0ddd292ef5. Matrix A_c has char polynomial X³−X²−c. For odd c mod2 polynomial is primitive irreducible, A_c order7, and checked B=(A_c^7−I)/2 plus I+B invertible mod2 for c=1,3 mod4; 2-adic matrix squaring yields period 7·2^(r−1) for nonzero valuation stratum, giving 4^(r−1) cycles. For even c the coprime x² and (x+1) factors lift the free Z_2^1 odd-unit root plus nilpotent rank-two summand; latter has no nonzero periodic vectors. Exact λ²(λ−1)=c and (λ+1)(λ²−2λ+2)=c+2 translate valuations to LTE unit orders and displayed length counts for c=0, v2(c)>=2, v2(c)=1 including c=−2. Independently enumerated 48 complete functional graphs for c in −8,−6,−4,−2,−1,0,1,2,3,4,6,8 and k1..4; all period histograms matched. Infinite proof uses Hensel and lift, not finite enumeration.
